subject: Board packet prep: forecast numbers + pipeline hygiene (ARR, commit review)
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Finance Team <finance@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: Prep: Board packet numbers — ARR, commits, and pipeline hygiene

Team —

Board packet deadline is next Friday. I need a clean set of numbers and a 1-paragraph forecast narrative that we can include in the deck. Action items:

- Sales: please update all opportunities in SFDC with current stage and committed/commit-prob assumptions by EOD Thursday. If a deal is "commit" please ensure the signed PO/contract is attached to the opportunity or add the procurement tracker link.
- Finance: reconcile ARR movements from cancellations and true-ups for Feb (I want an explicit +/-.
- Product/CS owners (if listed): confirm any revenue timing quirks (multi-year, upfront) so we don't double-count.

Attached is the current draft of the metrics spreadsheet (Q1 board metrics). I'm asking for conservative commit definitions this round — only deals with signed docs or legal-approved SOWs should be in commit.

Please reply with (1) what changed in committed bookings, (2) any deals moving out of commit and why, and (3) a suggested one-line forecast justification we can insert under guidance (example: "ARR growth driven by 3 enterprise renewals and one new platform expansion; discounts normalized during review").

I'll schedule a quick sync on Thursday morning for any last-minute alignment.

Thanks,
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: 2026-Q1-board-metrics-draft.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)
Attachment: sales-commit-log-20260224.csv (csv stub)

Thanks Marcus — quick updates from sales:

- Deal: AtlasHealth (HS-Deal-7482) — moving to commit. Signed PO expected by 02/27; legal flagged one SOW term, but procurement is approving. We'll mark as "conditional commit" in SFDC today with the note and link to PO tracker.
- Deal: FinOptics — pricing ask for a $50k concession to land the renewal. I've queued this for discount approval; if approved it remains commit. If not, it drops to best-case.
- Two mid-market deals (9-digit pipeline total) have moved from proposal -> negotiation; none are commit.

I'll attach the updated sales-commit-log after finalizing AtlasHealth docs. Question for finance: for ARR reconciliation, should we treat early renewals that invoice annually as recognized fully in ARR or prorated to term start?

-Marissa

Good questions. Answers inline: 

- AtlasHealth: mark as commit only once the signed PO is in SFDC and attached. Conditional commit is fine for internal visibility but do not include in board-level committed bookings until signature.
- Concessions: any discount >10% needs VP approval + finance sign-off to remain in commit. Otherwise move to best-case. Marissa, please route the FinOptics pricing ask through the discount approval form and copy finance.
- ARR recognition: Finance, please confirm the ARR treatment. My preference for board reporting is to use ARR as an annualized, contract-effective metric (prorated to term start) and to include a note on any material upfront prepayments separately on the revenue reconciliation tab.

Laura/Evelyn — can you take point on reconciliation and push an updated "ARR movements" worksheet into the Drive folder by EOD Thursday? Include line items for churn, true-ups, upsells, and enterprise timing adjustments.

I'll put together a 1-sentence forecast rationale draft and circulate.

Marcus
